stepNotes.1: Single export ProjectRoutes built inside lazy() at project.ts:12; four routes (list/current/git-init/update) mounted at /project by server.ts:299.
stepNotes.2: Client-controlled inputs are the :projectID path segment and the PATCH json body; both validated via PROJECT_ID_PARAM (route-params.ts:25) and Project.UpdateInput.omit({projectID:true}) (project.ts:112). No secrets or shell input cross this boundary.
stepNotes.3: POST /git/init short-circuits on prev.vcs==='git' (project.ts:77) and gates Instance.reload behind a triple equality check (project.ts:83) so idempotent calls skip the reboot; PATCH delegates to Project.update which throws a bare Error on miss (project.ts:382).
stepNotes.4: PATCH documents errors(400,404) but Project.update's plain Error('Project not found') is not matched by plainErrorEnvelope (error.ts:189-240), so clients get 500 not 404 — accepted as the unit's one MEDIUM finding.
stepNotes.5: No N+1; Project.list is a single select().all() filtered through safe() (project.ts:450); Instance.reload is heavy but guarded by the change-detection gate so repeats stay cheap.
stepNotes.6: Clean layering: route file owns only HTTP/validation concerns and delegates domain logic to Project/Instance; the route-level vcs guard at project.ts:77 mildly duplicates Project.initGit's internal guard (project.ts:476) but is justified to avoid an await round-trip.
stepNotes.7: No empty catches, no TODOs, all ten imports (Hono, describeRoute, validator, resolver, Instance, Project, errors, lazy, InstanceBootstrap, PROJECT_ID_PARAM, withProjectID) are used; UpdateInput.omit prevents body-driven projectID override.
stepNotes.8: project-init-git.test.ts covers POST /git/init with three cases (reload-on-init, skip-when-already-git, nested-subdir-noop); GET /, GET /current, and PATCH have no route-level tests, so the Step-4 status-code bug is uncaught.
stepNotes.9: One MEDIUM finding (404-vs-500 on PATCH); below Critical threshold so no reverify.md required; remediation is a one-line NotFoundError throw at project.ts:382 plus a route-level test, pending codex-sol verification.
